metadata.title: A Big Inflation Risk Still Looms for Stock Markets<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
A Big Inflation Risk Still Looms for Stock Markets
Stock markets and traders are breathing a sigh of relief after benign U.S. inflation data. But there’s no time to relax. Oil prices could still spring a nasty surprise as consumers feel the pinch of higher prices.
